source_preview:
AI Trainer – Job Description

Experience: 2–3 Years
Work Mode: On-site
Location: Mumbai (Vikhroli West)
Job Description
We are looking for an AI Trainer with 2–3 years of hands-on experience to deliver practical
training on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.
Key Responsibilities

•
Conduct classroom training sessions on AI, ML, and Generative AI

•
Deliver hands-on, industry-oriented projects and exercises

•
Mentor learners and provide technical guidance

•
Prepare and update training content

•
Stay updated with latest AI and GenAI tools and trends
Required Skills

•
Strong proficiency in Python for AI/ML

•
Knowledge of Machine Learning & Deep Learning concepts

•
Working experience with Generative AI & LLMs (ChatGPT, GPT, Prompt Engineering,
basic LangChain/RAG)

•
Understanding of NLP and Computer Vision fundamentals

•
Experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn

•
Data handling using Pandas, NumPy, and basic SQL

•
Familiarity with model evaluation, deployment basics, APIs, and REST services

•
Cloud exposure (AWS / GCP / Azure) is a plus

•
Good communication and training skills
